QuestInfo.name: Cygnus's Will
QuestInfo.1: Cygnus told you what it means to receive the will of the former empress.
QuestInfo.2: Cygnus told you what it means to receive the will of the former empress.

0.0: I heard you and Neinheart have been quite the pair lately! What's that all about, eh?\r\n#L0##bUh, it's nothing, your highness. Neinheart is just helping me, um, find my father. That's all.#l\n#k
0.1: I see. I can't help but feel like people are hiding their troubles to keep me from being upset..\r\n#b(Does she know?)\r\n#kIt's not like I can't deal with things. I'd do anything in my power to fulfill Lady Aria's dreams, I just worry sometimes that people think I'm too frail...

yes.0: Oh, sorry to gripe at you. Thank you for taking the time to hear me out. It feels good to speak my mind. Just let everything go out the other ear, okay? Hehehe!

no.0: You don't feel like listening to me?
